podcast.body: Featured on their second album "Truth and Soul," this song is an example of Fishbone's sound, which served as a crucial link between the second wave of Ska in the late 1970s/early 1980s and the subsequent third wave. "It's Ma and Pa. Fishbone. A band that served as vital connective tissue between the second wave of SCAT in the very late 70s and the early 80s and what was to come with the third wave."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song is featured on Fishbone's second album, "Truth and Soul," released in 1988. "This is Fishbone with Ma and Pa."
